user.title: OnOff - Zing Updater
user.description:
Pick which Zing packages (and the OnOff Licenser) to install. Each package is labelled with its type — Integration, Card, or Blueprint — and will be installed to the right place automatically.

You can install more later by clicking Configure on the integration.

reconfigure.title: Install more Zing packages
reconfigure.description: Pick packages to install. Packages already installed are preselected — leaving them checked will re-fetch and update them.

setup_restart_required.title: Restart required
setup_restart_required.description:
One or more integrations have been installed by OnOff - Zing Updater. Home Assistant must be restarted for the changes to take effect.

Go to Settings → System → Restart to restart Home Assistant.
